Jaw.description: One jaw: the level it draws at and its rows, the first in front.

level.description: How much of this jaw shows: none, bar or blocks.

TeethPreset.description: A teeth preset: tooth types and two jaws of rows of slots, from the middle outward, mirrored unless a slot says otherwise.

format.description: The grammar version of the file.

id.description: The name a mouth style's `teeth` and a group's `teeth.preset` use.

types.description: The tooth types its slots hold, by name.

upper.description: The upper jaw, riding the skull.

lower.description: The lower jaw, riding the jaw bone.

ToothRow.description: A row of slots from the middle outward, mirrored to the other side unless a slot says otherwise.

ToothSlot.description: One place in a row, from the middle outward: a tooth type, how far it sits from the slot before it, and any of the type's settings changed here.

type.description: The tooth type by name, from the preset's `types`.

gap.description: Space before this slot, after the one nearer the middle, or from the middle for the first; a share of the mouth's width.

at.description: Where the slot's middle sits along the row, its distance from the mouth's middle as a share of the mouth's width, in place of following the slot before it.

width.description: The type's width, changed for this slot.

length.description: The type's length, changed for this slot.

curve.description: The type's curve, changed for this slot.

tip.description: The type's tip, changed for this slot.

over.description: Whether it shows over the lips, open or shut, breaking their ink: incisors, fangs, a crocodile's lower teeth.

side.description: Which sides it fills: both, mirrored, unless left or right.

ToothType.description: A kind of tooth; sizes are shares of the mouth's width.

width.description: How wide the tooth is at its root.

length.description: How far it reaches from the lip's line, past it for the upper jaw and up from it for the lower.

tip.description: How its free end is cut: flat, round, point or chisel.

curve.description: How far its tip hooks toward the middle (above 0) or away from it (below 0), a share of its length.
